headline: Bajaj Finserv Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange about subscription of warrants convertible into equivalent number of Equity Shares for an aggregate consideration not exceeding Rs. 5,800 Crore by way of preferential issue by…
detail: Acquisition - Bajaj Finserv Limited has informed the Exchange about subscription of warrants convertible into equivalent number of Equity Shares for an aggregate consideration not exceeding Rs. 5,800 Crore by way of preferential issue by Bajaj Finance Limited.
